Definition: Mahalalel, the name of an antediluvian patriarch and of an Israelite
BiblicalUsage: Mahalalel was the antediluvian patriarch, son of Cainan and father of Jared, named in Genesis 5:12 and Genesis 5:15, where he lived sixty and five years and begat Jared and lived eight hundred and ninety and five years in all. A later Mahalaleel, of the children of Perez, is named in the Jerusalem list in Nehemiah 11:4.
TheologicalSignificance: I hold that the long lives in Genesis 5 are not filler: each name is a link in the chain from Adam to Noah, and Mahalalel holds his place in it.
